title: Top-Performer Relief — Seller Performance Standing Entitlement for Top Rated and Preferred Partner Sellers
content:
**Entitlement.** Top-performer relief is owed on the evaluation day, once that month's evaluation is recorded, to a seller placed at Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level whose standing record is in good standing or at risk and carries active points above zero; it takes points off before any violation's point expiry period has passed.

Top-performer relief is not worked out until every listing-type violation whose listing expiry period has run carries its expiry entry. Top-performer relief is not worked out until every serious violation whose first period has run carries its step-down entry. Said the other way, the relief is worked out on a Seller Performance Standing record on which each listing-type violation past its listing expiry period already shows its expiry entry, and each serious violation past its first period already shows its step-down entry.

For top-performer relief, whole calendar months are counted by calendar date back from the handling date: a date lies in the last N whole calendar months when fewer than N whole months have passed from it to the handling date.

## When it is owed

| Condition | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Day | the evaluation day, once that month's evaluation is recorded |
| Level the seller is placed at | Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level |
| Status of the standing record | good standing or at risk |
| Active points | above zero |

**Hypothetical cases.** A Preferred Partner Level seller at risk with active points on the record is owed the relief on the evaluation day. A Top Rated Level seller in good standing with active points on the record is likewise owed it, on the evaluation day once that month's evaluation is recorded.

## How the relief is booked

The top-performer relief is booked as one points-expiry entry against the active violation that still carries the most points, the oldest of them where two carry the same, and the entry carries that violation's type; where the relief exceeds that violation's remaining points, the rest is booked the same way against the next. A violation that has received top-performer relief keeps its remaining points on record until they expire, step down or are reversed, and a violation already reversed or fully expired never receives relief.

## Booking tool: `grant_top_performer_relief_7abd26c5`

**Capability.** Books a top-performer relief on a seller's Seller Performance Standing record: the given number of violation points comes off the seller's active violation points as relief for a seller placed at a top performance level, recorded as a points-expiry entry dated today against one policy violation. The active violation points shown on the standing record drop by exactly that number, and the entry appears in the seller's standing activity with today's date, the violation reference, its type and the points taken off.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, under the tool name `grant_top_performer_relief_7abd26c5`. Each call books one entry against one violation.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `standing_id` | Identifier: the reference number of the seller's performance standing record, read from the standing record lookup. |
| `violation_ref` | Identifier: the policy violation reference number the entry is booked against, read from the seller's standing activity. |
| `violation_type` | Enum: the kind of policy violation the entry is booked against, copied from that violation's record; exactly one of `listing_policy`, `restricted_product`, `intellectual_property`, `inauthentic_complaint`, `product_authenticity`, `review_manipulation`. |
| `points` | Fixed format: the number of violation points taken off as relief, a positive whole number (integer points, no decimals). |

**Return.** A receipt with `entry_id` (reference of the new points-expiry entry), `standing_id`, `violation_ref`, `points` (points taken off), `active_points_before` and `active_points_after`. A returned `entry_id` means the entry is booked and the standing record already shows `active_points_after`.
